description: em.power dispatch is a model listed in Open Energy Platform model and framework factsheets, a public register of energy-system model and framework factsheets under the section "Models", published or maintained by not stated on the factsheet. This model is a linear cost-minimization model that calculates day-ahead electricity prices for the German power market. It represents market participants’ generation and dispatch decisions and determines the market-clearing price based on the cost-optimal allocation of available generation capacities. Coverage: Europe. Methodical focus: Electricity Prices in Germany, Technology Dispatch in the German Power Market. Time resolution: hour. Spatial resolution: Fokus is the bidding zone DE/LU. The rest of Europe is modelled in decreasing resolution.. Software: GAMS. The listed link gives the source code or documentation; nothing was downloaded or run. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Unknown. Caveats: this record was written from the Open Energy Platform factsheet only, so the code, documentation and any publication it links were not opened, their current availability was not checked, and the factsheet may lag the project. It can support energy-system planning and scenario studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-oep-factsheet-catalogue.
